description: Review how your social media content is performing through the Marky API, find what is working, and turn it into a concrete plan. Use this when you want to know your top posts, follower growth, and which topics, formats, and platforms get the best engagement, then get specific recommendations (and optionally act on them). Pulls per-post stats, account stats, and your post history. Reads auth and endpoints from the marky-api skill. Also triggers on "how are my posts doing", "what's working", "top posts last month". For a quick queue/account status, use /marky-status.
